propositions: MCP-only agents cannot query whether a plan-review attestation is current; they only discover staleness by provoking a refusal error
The CLI tool `rebar review-plan <id> --status` exists but has no corresponding MCP tool exposing the same read-only check

A new read-only MCP tool `plan_review_status` must be registered in `register_read_tools` and absent from `register_write_tools` to enable agents to check attestation currency without triggering write operations

The tool must delegate to the existing `rebar.llm.plan_review_status` library function and return a structured `PlanReviewStatusOut` model with fields `{ok, verdict, reason, verified_at_sha, signed_at}`
The tool's schema must be canonically defined in `src/rebar/schemas/plan_review_status.schema.json` and registered in the schema coverage guard to pass interface tests
